title: From Tables to Time: Extending TabPFN-v2 to Time Series Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2501.02945v5 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Recent progress in foundation models has enabled strong zero-shot performance for time series forecasting. In this work, we show that such capabilities can also emerge from tabular foundation models. We introduce TabPFN-TS, a simple method that treats forecasting as a tabular regression problem by combining lightweight temporal featurization with the pretrained TabPFN-v2. This formulation requires no time-series-specific pretraining and naturally supports both univariate and covariate-informed forecasting. Despite its compact size (11M parameters), TabPFN-TS achieves state-of-the-art performance on covariate-informed forecasting and competitive accuracy on univariate forecasting across the GIFT-Eval and fev-bench benchmarks. We further provide controlled analyses examining how the model interprets temporal structure, how featurization choices affect accuracy, and how forecasts change under alternative tabular backbones. translated_title: 从表格到时间：将TabPFN-v2扩展至时间序列预测
translated_abstract: 基础模型的最新进展已经使时间序列预测具备了强大的零样本性能。在这项工作中，我们证明这种能力也可以从表格基础模型中涌现。我们提出了TabPFN-TS，这是一种简单的方法，通过将轻量级的时间特征化与预训练的TabPFN-v2相结合，将预测任务视为表格回归问题。这种构造无需任何针对时间序列的专门预训练，并且天然支持单变量预测和协变量信息预测。尽管模型规模紧凑（仅1100万参数），TabPFN-TS在GIFT-Eval和fev-bench基准测试中，在协变量信息预测上取得了最先进的性能，在单变量预测上也取得了具有竞争力的准确率。我们还提供了控制变量分析，研究模型如何解读时间结构、特征化选择如何影响准确率，以及在替换不同表格骨干网络时预测结果如何变化。
tldr: 该论文提出TabPFN-TS，通过轻量级时间特征化将预训练表格基础模型TabPFN-v2应用于表格回归，从而无需时间序列专门预训练，仅以1100万参数即在协变量信息预测上达到最先进水平，并在单变量预测上表现出竞争力。
en_tdlr: TabPFN-TS reformulates time series forecasting as tabular regression by combining lightweight temporal featurization with the pretrained TabPFN-v2, achieving state-of-the-art covariate-informed forecasting and competitive univariate accuracy with only 11M parameters and no time-series-specific pretraining.
